Class Pirates

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Enemies
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Pirates
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Pirates extends Enemies
Represents the "Pirates" enemy card. Players must defeat pirates using cannon power; if they fail, their ship may suffer damage through randomized projectile impacts.
